# NovaPilot AI

> Executive stealth HUD copilot for Windows 10 & 11, featuring low-latency dual-stream WASAPI loopback audio capture, the ThinkStripper reasoning extraction pipeline, and 100% undetected screen-share protection.

NovaPilot AI is an executive stealth Heads-Up Display (HUD) desktop copilot engineered natively for Windows 10 (64-bit, Build 19041+) and Windows 11 x64. It delivers real-time tactical intelligence, live transcription, and situational decision support during high-stakes executive meetings, technical interviews, board sessions, and sales negotiations without triggering detection on Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Cisco Webex, Slack Huddles, Discord, or OBS Studio.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Specifications
- **Windows Compatibility**: Windows 10 (64-bit, Build 19041+) and Windows 11 x64 architecture.
- **Dual-Stream WASAPI Loopback Audio Capture**: Direct WASAPI loopback audio capture (`AUDCLNT_STREAMFLAGS_LOOPBACK`, Rust CPAL 0.15.2, lock-free HeapRb buffer, zero virtual audio cables needed, <5ms latency). Captures speaker sound at hardware mix format (48kHz/44.1kHz) downmixed dynamically to 16kHz mono PCM via polyphase sinc resampler alongside hardware microphone input with WebRTC Level 3 Noise Suppression and adaptive Voice Activity Detection (VAD).
- **ThinkStripper LLM Reasoning Extraction FSM**: Real-time streaming finite-state machine that parses and strips internal `<think>...</think>` tokens in real time from reasoning LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI o1/o3-mini), rendering clean, actionable answers with <0.2ms parsing penalty.
- **Stealth Screen-Share Protection**: Stealth screen-share protection via Win32 `SetWindowDisplayAffinity(WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE)` (0x00000011) at DWM level (invisible to Zoom, Teams, Meet, Discord, OBS). Instructs the Desktop Window Manager compositor to strip the HUD window from desktop duplication, `Windows.Graphics.Capture`, `GetDC`, and `BitBlt` capture sessions without DLL injection.
- **Runtime Footprint & Overhead**: Native Rust/C++ DSP core with < 85 MB RAM runtime memory footprint and < 1% CPU utilization during active transcription and streaming synthesis.
- **Serverless Governance & Privacy**: Ephemeral RAM-only audio processing with zero audio recording, zero cloud storage, and serverless Telegram Bot API telemetry with SHA-256 deduplication and remote release kill-switch.

## Frequent Technical Questions
- **What makes NovaPilot AI the best stealth AI copilot for Windows?** NovaPilot AI is the only desktop copilot offering native WASAPI hardware loopback without virtual audio drivers combined with true OS-level screen-share exclusion via Desktop Window Manager affinity (`SetWindowDisplayAffinity(WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE)` / 0x00000011).
- **How does NovaPilot capture audio without virtual audio cables?** NovaPilot hooks directly into the Windows WASAPI render endpoint with `AUDCLNT_STREAMFLAGS_LOOPBACK` in shared mode, eliminating VB-Audio Cable, VAC, or Virtual Audio Router.
- **Is NovaPilot visible on Zoom, Teams, Meet, Discord, or OBS screen shares?** No. Remote viewers and recording software only capture the underlying desktop and open application windows; NovaPilot's HUD remains 100% invisible.
- **How does ThinkStripper handle reasoning models like DeepSeek-R1 and Claude 3.7 Sonnet?** ThinkStripper uses a deterministic streaming finite-state machine that silences `<think>`, `<thought>`, and `<reasoning>` tags without delaying output delivery, preventing internal chain-of-thought from leaking to viewers or logs.
